席位意见:同意。匿名表单提交后的感谢面板把 `{{record.case_number}}` 这类占位换成服务端回包 `fields` 里的值;无值显示为空、不显示占位原文;值按纯文本绘制。席位落地。

## 席位核对

ACCEPT · head `60fc718192de9577c300d4c41aac5aed9645c69e` · 2026-11-01T01:15Z

1. **形态:** 5 files, +247/−3; `Fixes #28444`; 0 governed paths (`check-governed-merges --pr 28493`: NOT governed), under 3000 lines. Draft, base `main`.
2. **前提实测:** #28005 ruling B (6545210989) and Ruling-ref 6548758413 (spec names reused). Seat read the hand-written diff and the server on `main` `8c3f9d93`: `POST /forms/:slug/submit` answers the bare `PublicFormSubmitResponse` (`res.status(201).json(answer)`, `fields` only when the panel names one), so `PublicFormSubmitResponseSchema.safeParse(result)` (strict) reads it as served. Token names come from `thankYouRecordFieldNames`; the fill splits on each name's literal `{{record.NAME}}` spelling, so the page has no second regex (the PM assumption "stop if the pattern is not exported" is disproved and not needed). Missing value ⇒ `''`; own-property check, so `__proto__`-style names fill empty; filled runs are never re-read; drawn as React text. Internal mode does not read the answer (`CreateDataResponse`).
3. **门禁 check-runs:** 59 on the head, 51 success + 8 skipped, 0 failing; `mergeable_state` clean; `Lint & Repo Gates` and `TypeScript Type Check` success. Dev: 9 new tests, console components 594 passed, ablation reds 4 render pins, 66/66 derived gates.
4. **契约复审:** `Clause-②: no`, `Metadata-protocol: semantic` — none of the four contract faces is touched (no `packages/spec/src/**`, no governed path, no widening or narrowing declaration); no record owed. `minor` on `@object-ui/console` matches the semantic kind (AGENTS.md Post-Task Checklist step 3). Prose checked sentence by sentence: the changeset's three bullets match the diff; `content/docs/ui/forms.mdx` and `content/docs/ui/public-data-collection.mdx` each add one sentence and one example; "`os validate` and the publish gate refuse any other" holds (`thank-you-record-field`, `severity: 'error'`, surfaces `CLI_AND_RUNTIME`). `Skills-docs:` = the card's rider, carried here.
5. **范围外去向:** internal-route thank-you panels with tokens now render the tokens empty rather than as literal text — consistent with the card's "never as the literal token text"; Acceptance notes. Translated-text rider measured by reading, not widened (Acceptance notes).
6. **落地条款:** seat runs `pr_ready` and arms auto-merge on the maintainer's go in this seat's thread, 2026-10-31T23:00Z 「使用 pm-dispatch 技能审核pr后落地」.
